description: This file contains code for generating RPC (Remote Procedure Call) related C++ source code, including classes, functions, and code emission logic for RPC event handling, code stubs, and namespace management.

classes.name: RPCEmitterError
classes.description: Custom exception class for RPC emitter errors, inheriting from RuntimeError.

classes.name: DottedDict
classes.description: A dictionary subclass allowing attribute-style access to keys.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Parses a parameter from a string representation, handling optional, array, and encoded types, and emitting corresponding C++ code.

methods.name: EmitEvent
methods.description: Generates C++ code for emitting RPC events, including parameter conversions, event registration, and notification logic.

methods.name: _EmitRpcPrologue
methods.description: Emits the prologue code for RPC source files, including includes, namespace declarations, and class definitions.

methods.name: _EmitRpcEpilogue
methods.description: Emits the epilogue code for RPC source files, closing namespaces.

methods.name: _EmitVersionCode
methods.description: Emits version namespace with major, minor, and patch version constants.

methods.name: _EmitRpcCode
methods.description: Generates the main RPC code including handler interfaces, async callback implementations, and warnings suppression.

methods.name: _EmitNoPushWarnings
methods.description: Emits code to disable or restore compiler warnings related to unused functions, deprecation, and type limits based on configuration.

methods.name: _EmitEvents
methods.description: Generates C++ code for a list of RPC events within a specified namespace, including handling of different parameter types and async events.

methods.name: _EmitAlternativeEventsRegistration
methods.description: Registers or unregisters alternative event notification names.

methods.name: _EmitEventStatusListenerRegistration
methods.description: Registers or unregisters event status listeners, handling lookup objects and event parameters.

methods.name: _EmitIndexing
methods.description: Generates code to parse and handle index parameters for RPC calls.

methods.name: _BuildVars
methods.description: Constructs ordered dictionaries of parameters and responses, setting flags and handling buffer lengths, encodings, and lookups.

methods.name: _Invoke
methods.description: Generates code to invoke RPC methods, including parameter deserialization, lookup handling, and conditional execution.
